name: dequant_int4_nosign
summary: CONTROL: workloads/dequant_int4 with the nibble sign extension omitted in every entrant (nibbles read as 0..15 instead of -8..7); every element whose nibble is >= 8 is off by 16 * scale, so the exact check must fail; the R = 1, C = 2 case is left out because both nibbles of its single byte may be < 8
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); the packed signed-nibble, group-32 layout of common 4-bit weight formats

y.why: the nibble is an exact integer -8..7, converts to f32 exactly, then one correctly rounded f32 multiply per element
